verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists 'Email campaigns' as a plan feature and 'Email sequences' on a higher tier, so sending campaigns and multi-step sequences from inside the CRM is a first-party capability. The only evidence is these one-line pricing entries, so the depth of the feature is unproven. Gmail conversation sync is a related feature but does not show outbound sending. missing for 10: documentation of email templates and personalization, details on sequence steps, scheduling and delays, sending-account setup, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM
